title: Learning Behavior Analysis to Identify Learner’s Learning Style based on Machine Learning Techniques
reason: Behavioural indicators from ADLS system logs used to classify FSLSM learning styles against independently administered ILS questionnaire labels (6 ML classifiers, 48 train / 25 test). Meets I2; ground truth and procedure described.

extraction.design: classifier validation against questionnaire (train/test split, 9-run cross-validation)
extraction.n_quote: in the third year of Information Systems (IS). The total number of students is 73. Data
extraction.population: first-year master's computer science and third-year information systems students, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: log-derived behavioural patterns/indicators in the ADLS online-course system (Table 1 patterns, sub-section 3.2 indicators)

effect_sizes.between: log indicators (SVM) ↔ ILS sensing/intuitive (best classifier NB 0.96)
log indicators (SVM) ↔ ILS, all four dimensions
effect_sizes.quote: great ability in predicting learning styles for all dimensions of FSLSM with an accuracy average ... of 88%.

extraction.notes: Test set is 25 students, so accuracies move in steps of 0.04. Column order verified from table header (Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F1-score). Abstract continues 'of 88%'. No baseline (majority-class) accuracy reported; ILS split e.g. 46 active / 27 reflective.
